input.quote: 2.7 Restrictions. Corio may not copy, distribute, reproduce, use or allow access to the Software or the MarketSite.net Service except as explicitly permitted under this Agreement
input.rationale: No non-compete, field-of-use or "competing products" covenant binds Corio anywhere in the Agreement. Section 2.7 is a conventional intellectual-property use restriction on the licensed Software (no copying/reverse engineering), not a limit on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. The "Territory" (North America, §1.11) and "Corio Market Segment" (customers under $1B revenue, §1.3) definitions merely delimit the scope of the license Commerce One grants us — they do not prohibit Corio from hosting, developing or reselling other or competing solutions, and §2.10 lets us seek worldwide expansion with consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Section 13.6 expressly preserves each party's right to develop independently. Searches for "compete/competing", "exclusive", "shall not", "may not", "solicit" and "restrict" surfaced no covenant restricting our business, and no post-term restriction survives under §11.3. This meets the preferred position (no restriction on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
